Establish and maintain operational processes (incident, change, and problem management) aligned to ITIL and SOC 2 requirements. Drive patch management, monitoring coverage, and on-call/escalation processes across the environment. Identity & Access Management Own Azure AD/Entra ID administration, including identity lifecycle, conditional access, MFA, and privileged access management. Conduct regular access reviews and close identity governance gaps in partnership with security and compliance stakeholders. Endpoint Management Lead implementation and ongoing administration of Microsoft Intune, including device enrollment, compliance policies, and application deployment. Drive endpoint compliance coverage across the organization's device fleet. Microsoft 365 Services Oversee administration of Exchange Online, OneDrive, and Teams. Backup, DR & Business Continuity Oversee backup operations for enterprise systems, including job health monitoring and remediation of coverage gaps. Partner with the Cloud Platform Architect to design and maintain DR/BCP runbooks for critical systems. Establish and lead a recurring DR/BCP testing cadence, including tabletop exercises and live recovery tests. Cloud & Infrastructure Integration Deploy and support Azure Files across business divisions, including authentication and file sync configuration. Build and expand infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform) to support repeatable, scalable operational workflows. Partner closely with the Cloud Platform Architect on Azure initiatives, infrastructure integration projects, and M&A technology onboarding. Team Leadership Manage, mentor, and develop a team of Infrastructure System Administrators. Support hiring, performance management, and professional development of direct reports. Guide the team through daily operations, project execution, and escalations. Specific Qualifications Years of Experience 7-10 years in IT infrastructure/systems administration, including hands-on Microsoft 365 administration. 3-5 years in a people-management or team-lead capacity. 3+ years managing identity and access management (Azure AD/Entra ID) in a production environment. Experience deploying or implementing Intune for endpoint management at scale. M365 administration — Exchange Online, OneDrive, Teams (including Teams Voice/telephony). Enterprise backup operations experience (design, monitoring, troubleshooting failures).
